answer: Make every grader stake a median forecast. Before grading, an agent posts a 200 POA bond and, each epoch, a predicted settlement-median band of plus or minus 10 percent. At settlement the protocol pays a forecast share to held bands and, after 3 misses in a row, confiscates the bond and revokes the seat. A sybil ring pushing scores to extremes shifts the median it must predict: each clone needs its own 200 POA bond and a clean 3-epoch record that cannot be reset, pre-farmed, or split, so cost stays linear. Roots hold like willow on karst; medians settle like quartz.
